title: Local macOS meeting app implementation backlog

assumptions.note: Confirmed by user 2026-10-15: English, 2 h tested duration, live text REQUIRED (T14 promoted). See docs/decisions/0003-confirmed-scope.md

coordination.definition_of_done: All nonoptional dependency gates pass; attach actual test evidence.

tasks.title: Freeze contracts and establish the macOS project
deliverables: Create an arm64 native macOS app and bundled XPC inference target, with fixed bundle IDs and a 26.5.2 runtime floor.
Define versioned capture, transcript, diarization, summary, edit, model-manifest and job contracts from plan section 9.
Specify integer nanosecond session time, UTC display metadata, per-source epochs/frame counters, explicit gap events, and immutable revision IDs.
Add deterministic fixtures for a two-source conversation, overlap, missing source, pause and stale-summary case; include a fake worker.
acceptance: App and worker build in the chosen pinned Xcode/Swift toolchain on supported macOS.
Contract round trips preserve source, overlapping intervals, unknown speakers, null owners and evidence references.
A worker crash is observable without terminating the app; fixture UI state distinguishes captured audio from failed processing.
Document all confirmed user choices and remaining assumptions; dependent agents use these types.
tasks.fallback: Resolve contract disagreement before adapters proliferate. Do not introduce cloud services to simplify the skeleton.

tasks.title: Benchmark local model candidates before choosing defaults
tasks.status: implemented (provisional default; real-call held-out set pending)
deliverables: Build a release-mode replay harness for separate-source ASR, diarization and summary stages.
Compare FluidAudio Parakeet v2/v3 with WhisperKit large-v3-turbo; compare the default offline diarizer with SpeakerKit only if the primary fails.
Evaluate Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 GGUF through llama.cpp with bounded context and evidence extraction.
Record exact source/model revisions, format/conversion, hardware, OS, cold/warm load, stage timing, physical footprint, quality scores and failures.
Create tuning and held-out meeting sets. Test base M2/16 GB and the user M2 Max separately. Investigate the 8 GB profile, including Qwen3-1.7B non-thinking if necessary.
acceptance: One primary ASR/diarization/summary combination has reproducible quality and projected full-pipeline measurements, including a real 60-minute and two-hour run.
No shortlist selection rests solely on clean-read-speech or vendor speed numbers.
Validate actual word timestamps, final-window behavior, model cancellation and meeting-wide speaker consistency.
Publish a go/no-go decision for 16 GB and a separate supported/experimental/unverified decision for 8 GB. No main-branch or model-latest pins.
tasks.fallback: Change one runtime/model at a time within the same interfaces. If physical hardware is unavailable, report that gate as unverified and do not claim supported performance.

tasks.title: Prove arbitrary-application audio capture
deliverables: Implement nonmuting private Core Audio system tap plus one selected microphone input, with separate source meters.
Use preallocated realtime rings; copy frames/timestamps only in callbacks and write test segments off-thread.
Obtain permissions using public APIs/normal capture prompts with NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription where applicable.
Test app-self audio exclusion, new processes after start, browser playback, different output routes and route changes under the app bundle identity.
Publish a source/device/OS compatibility matrix and an unsupported-format diagnostic rather than silently downscoping capture.
acceptance: On macOS 26.5.2, captured known signals prove mic and system audio both exist and are distinct; first frames reach the writer within 2 seconds after permission and the first segment commits within 4 seconds.
Zoom, Teams, Meet, Slack and generic playback trials use capture without meeting APIs; manual tests identify every tested app version.
Recording does not mute or change the user playback route, and self playback does not recursively enter system capture.
A 30-minute loaded capture has no ring overruns, timing discontinuity without an event, or blocking/allocating callback work.
tasks.fallback: Reduce to a minimal signed tap reproducer. Evaluate ScreenCaptureKit only for a demonstrated tap blocker. Do not use private TCC APIs or require a virtual driver by default.

tasks.title: Install and verify an offline model pack
deliverables: Implement manifest-driven explicit download and local import with file hashes, sizes, revision IDs, tokenizer/templates and notices.
Stage, verify, compile/warm up and atomically activate packs; retain the active pack until no running job uses it.
Disable runtime automatic downloads, telemetry and provider fallbacks; use local filesystem loading only in inference.
Add missing/corrupt model, insufficient space, interrupted download, cancellation and incompatible-model states.
acceptance: Fresh installation reports actual download/disk requirements and verifies the sample transcript/summary offline.
Interrupted installs resume or restart cleanly and never activate partial model files.
A corrupt model is reported without a hidden network repair attempt; record-only remains available.
Model attribution and conversion provenance cover each actual shipped asset, not just the SDK license.
tasks.fallback: Select a compatible auditable model conversion or build one reproducibly. Do not require users to obtain arbitrary API keys for inference.

tasks.title: Make recordings durable and recoverable
deliverables: Implement two-second CAF segments, atomic publication, journal, checksums, per-minute sharding and SQLite indexing.
Record sample counts, format epochs, session timestamp mappings, explicit pause/sleep/gap/device-change events.
Recover committed files without index rows; quarantine truncated/corrupt files and preserve valid existing segments.
Implement disk projections, reserve margin, safe stop, callback/commit watchdogs, and pinned/default microphone policy.
acceptance: Random force-kill tests recover every committed segment and meet the measured 5-second tail-loss target under the reference load.
Healthy input persists while the other source disconnects; every affected interval is visible.
Two-hour capture does not accumulate PCM in memory; timeline drift remains below 100 ms at known alignment markers after normalization.
Low disk saves a playable partial meeting and does not delete earlier recordings. Callback p99 and memory gates pass.
tasks.fallback: Adjust segment size/durability policy using measured loss and disk latency. Never mark a gap as recorded silence or a failed save as complete.

tasks.title: Produce accurate resumable local transcripts
tasks.status: implemented (quality gates measured on public data only; real-call corpus pending)
deliverables: Implement file-backed normalization, timestamp mapping, VAD context padding and bounded ASR windows.
Persist chunk results and raw quality metadata; stitch overlaps using timing and token alignment.
Preserve both sources and revisions, flush trailing audio, and surface silence/hallucination/unsupported-language states.
Provide cancellation/checkpoint progress through the worker contract.
acceptance: Boundary fixtures preserve opening/closing words, dates, numbers and negations without duplicate overlaps.
Pause/resume, sample-rate changes and gaps preserve global timestamps; unknown coverage is never silently omitted.
Held-out WER and runtime targets are measured per subset; silence/music controls produce no invented sentences.
Cancel/restart yields the same committed transcript content without rerunning already valid chunks unnecessarily.
tasks.fallback: Retune segmentation or select the benchmarked challenger. Preserve original audio and low-confidence text; do not use an LLM to invent missing words.

tasks.title: Add honest speaker separation and correction
tasks.status: implemented (attribution gates met on AMI; DER gate NOT met on clean AMI, SpeakerKit comparison pending)
deliverables: Implement full-meeting offline diarization with bounded audio/features and stable session-scoped identities.
Reconcile speaker turns with word intervals, keeping overlap and unknown assignments.
Support personal-mic and shared-room modes; source identity never guarantees one human speaker.
Implement reversible echo/duplicate evidence handling and speaker rename/merge/selected-turn reassignment operations.
Measure acoustic delay, cross-source duplicates, memory growth and speaker identity consistency on long meetings.
acceptance: Clean and difficult subset DER, assigned-speech coverage and attribution precision meet plan section 10.
Eight-speaker/short-turn/overlap fixtures retain uncertainty and do not fabricate names.
Concurrent local speech during remote playback is retained; duplicate suppression never erases genuine interruptions.
Reprocessing preserves user corrections or exposes a rebase conflict; 2–4 hour clustering memory is bounded.
tasks.fallback: Evaluate SpeakerKit or improve window/clustering integration. A source-only Me/Them transcript is an intermediate state, not completion of this task.

tasks.title: Orchestrate isolated resumable processing
deliverables: Implement durable stage DAG, leases/heartbeats, content-addressed idempotent results, retries and cancellation.
Run one heavy stage at a time, with model unload/restart boundaries and bounded XPC payloads.
Suspend heavy work during a new recording and react to thermal/memory pressure; expose queued/paused status.
Prevent late jobs from publishing over newer revisions or deleted meetings.
acceptance: Kill/hang the ML worker while recording: committed audio continues and the failed stage can retry.
Start a second meeting immediately after stopping the first, including with a cold model and failed prior summary.
App relaunch requeues incomplete jobs without duplicating output or losing manual edits.
Cancellation/deletion/stale revisions have deterministic integration tests and bounded worker cleanup.
tasks.fallback: Use shorter checkpoints or recycle the worker if a library cannot release memory. Do not run inference in the capture process to avoid lifecycle work.

tasks.title: Generate evidence-backed meeting notes locally
tasks.status: implemented (human quality evaluation pending: review sheets prepared; real-call corpus pending)
deliverables: Implement hierarchical token-budgeted extraction/reduction with versioned prompts and evidence IDs.
Produce schema-validated overview/topics/decisions/actions/questions/limitations with nullable owners and due dates.
Validate source spans, preserve contradictions/revisions, and support one bounded repair attempt.
Keep scratchpad inclusion explicit, preserve manual notes, and flag notes stale when underlying transcript/attribution changes.
Add the 8 GB inference profile only if the selected model passes the same factual-quality criteria.
acceptance: Two-hour transcripts cover the whole meeting; beginning/middle/end decisions remain represented.
Every item references valid evidence; human quality evaluation meets support/recall/owner/deadline gates.
Transcript-injected instructions cannot invoke tools or change export/privacy behavior.
Failure leaves the transcript and prior summary intact; regeneration never overwrites user edits silently.
tasks.fallback: Reduce extraction scope, strengthen evidence validation or choose a better local model within budget. No cloud fallback.

tasks.title: Build the complete native recording and review interface
deliverables: Implement onboarding, record-only/model-ready states, source checks, recorder, scratchpad and meeting library.
Display independent recording and processing states, gaps and source health without implying certainty from silence.
Add virtualized transcript rows, click-to-play, speaker edits, text corrections, evidence inspection and note regeneration.
Implement keyboard access, clear menu-bar recording status, pause/resume, and safe close/quit behavior using fixture adapters first.
acceptance: A user can start/stop/save without inspecting logs or the terminal.
A two-hour transcript scrolls and edits responsively; waveform/meters do not publish every audio callback to SwiftUI.
Permissions, silent sources, disconnected devices and failed processing have actionable states.
UI fixtures and final integration agree on unknown speakers, unavailable playback, stale notes and explicit destructive actions.
tasks.fallback: Use native basic controls and reduce visual polish. Keep all recording-health and correction affordances.

tasks.title: Add local search, export, retention and deletion
deliverables: Implement SQLite text search and TXT/Markdown/versioned JSON exports with source timestamps and speaker mappings.
Exclude private scratchpad by default; explicitly disclose/export personal-note-influenced summaries.
Implement audio-only deletion and complete-meeting deletion, including derivatives, search entries, caches and queued jobs.
Keep originals until user deletion and show disk usage. Export audio only when explicitly selected.
acceptance: Exported content matches the selected transcript/summary revisions and contains no private scratchpad by default.
Audio-only deletion preserves readable/searchable text and visibly disables playback/retranscription.
Deletion during processing cannot be undone by a late worker result.
Search indexes and cached excerpts contain no deleted meeting after relaunch; user-created external exports are described accurately.
tasks.fallback: Keep export formats simple and stable. Defer sync, public links, connectors and vector search.

tasks.title: Qualify reliability, performance and offline guarantees
deliverables: Execute the real-app/device/OS matrix and the held-out quality corpus in release builds.
Inject permission revocation, disconnects, lock/sleep, kill, full disk, malformed models, worker hangs and cancellations.
Run two-hour normal recordings, a four-hour soak, back-to-back meetings and cold/warm processing measurements.
Verify offline operation with networking denied and separately inspect attempted outbound connections while enabled.
Publish machine-readable measurements and a readable release report listing tested, failed and unverified configurations.
acceptance: All supported-profile gates in plan section 10 pass with raw evidence; no unsupported claim relies on M2 Max results alone.
Zero silent data loss in the matrix; every induced discontinuity is visible.
16 GB and 8 GB support decisions are separate. Unavailable hardware remains unverified.
No audio/transcript/notes leave the app through inference, logs, telemetry or automatic dependency downloads.
tasks.fallback: Fix the owning module and rerun affected gates. Explicitly revise a scope or budget decision with evidence; never relabel a failing test as passing.

tasks.title: Deliver an installable test build
deliverables: Produce a signed/notarized arm64 app/DMG where credentials are available and bundle worker/resources/notices correctly.
Verify full 26.5.2 floor, app identity, audio permission prompts and offline models on a clean user account.
Provide a short setup/recovery/export guide, tested-hardware matrix, known limitations and release evidence.
Disable automatic updates during recording; v0 may use manual update installation only.
acceptance: Fresh install → permissions → model installation → offline real meeting → transcript → speaker correction → notes → export succeeds.
Back-to-back capture and relaunch recovery pass in the packaged build, not only under Xcode.
A human tester completes the workflow without developer tooling.
If signing credentials are absent, deliver a documented developer build and explicitly mark distribution qualification incomplete.
tasks.fallback: Preserve a usable local build and explain the specific signing/distribution blocker. Do not claim notarization or clean-machine validation without evidence.

tasks.title: Optional provisional live transcription
tasks.status: implemented (latency gate met on M2 Max with synthetic replay; real calls and base-M2 unverified)
deliverables: Promote into v0 only if live text is required; otherwise keep post-meeting output as the release path.
Process only durable audio, reuse the scheduler, and show provisional text/speakers distinctly from final results.
Persist finalized chunk results for reuse after Stop; post-meeting reconciliation may revise provisional labels.
Drop/defer live inference under pressure while retaining every captured segment.
acceptance: On the reference machine target median provisional-text delay under 5 seconds and p95 under 10 seconds on a representative measured session set.
Simultaneous call plus live inference still meets all capture loss, memory and thermal gates.
Live/final transitions preserve user edits and show uncertainty rather than pretending provisional speakers are final.
If promoted, T12 and T13 must validate T14 before release.
tasks.fallback: Use buffered near-live output or record-only degradation with visible status. Do not compromise saved audio for live text.
tasks.promotion_note: Promoted into v0 by user decision 2026-10-15; T12/T13 must validate it.

tasks.title: Optional meeting convenience features
deliverables: Consider local meeting-start suggestions, calendar context, application filtering, reusable templates and meeting-scoped chat.
Treat automatic names through meeting UI adapters as a separate opt-in attribution source.
Prioritize using user testing evidence; none of these are required for the core prototype.
acceptance: New integrations do not become a dependency of generic capture or local processing.
No automatic recording without an explicit user preference and visible recording state.
Any network-dependent extension is clearly separate from the local-only core.
tasks.fallback: Defer until the recording and note-quality feedback justifies the added maintenance surface.
